title: Signed duplicate appointment letter
requirements: Sign and return the duplicate copy of your appointment letter.

title: Medical fitness certificate and test reports
requirements: Obtain the certificate from a recognised government or private hospital or practitioner. HR will verify it later. Check the test abbreviations against the original appointment letter.
checklist: Final certificate from hospital or doctor

title: Bank service sheet
requirements: Fill in and sign the prescribed service sheet provided by the Bank.

title: Declaration of fidelity and secrecy
requirements: Sign the fidelity and secrecy bond on the form provided by the Bank.

title: Nationality certificate
requirements: Obtain the certificate from a UP Chairman, Mayor of a Pourashava, or Ward Councillor of a City Corporation.

title: Attested photocopy of National ID card
requirements: Bring an attested photocopy of your National ID card.

title: Declaration of academic certificate genuineness
requirements: Complete the form provided by the Bank. A false certificate is grounds for termination.

title: Undertaking to serve at any branch or office
requirements: Complete the undertaking on the form provided by the Bank.

title: Character and antecedent certificate #1
requirements: Get a certificate from a Class-I government official or a banker of AGM rank or above. The signer must not be a relative.

title: Character and antecedent certificate #2
requirements: Use a different signer from certificate #1. The same rank and non-relative requirements apply.

title: Surety bond on Tk 300 stamp paper
requirements: Use the prescribed proforma and Tk 300 non-judicial stamp paper. The bond covers at least five years of service from joining.

title: Attested passport-size colour photographs
requirements: Bring four recent lab-printed photos attested by a Class-I government official or a banker of AGM rank or above.

title: Original academic certificates
requirements: Bring all original academic certificates on joining day. The Bank will return them after verification.

title: Attested copies of academic certificates
requirements: Bring two complete sets of attested photocopies of your academic certificates.

title: Release order from previous employer
requirements: The release order must mention any liabilities with your previous organisation.
